label: Bookings
purpose: Sales, cost, profit and counts of booking lines (hotels, generic bookings, tickets, transfers) of Global Travel Engine / Dubai Link Direct in AED, from 2014 to today. The main cube for sales, profit and booking volumes.
grain: One booking line (reservation service); [Reservations Count] counts them, cancelled lines included.
use_for: room nights, nights, rooms and passengers
cancellations (by cancellation date or the cancelled flag)
breakdowns by customer, market, channel, supplier, destination, product type and hotel
not_for: API search and request volumes (Statistics cubes)
owned vs third-party hotel split (Sales Per Owned Hotels)
other currencies: all amounts are AED

coverage.note: Complete monthly data since mid-2014 (very small volumes in 2014); the current month is partial. 2020 is low (pandemic). Counts, nights and passengers include cancelled lines.

dates.label: Booking date
dates.meaning: When the booking was made: the cube's main date, used by the company's reports. Plain period questions use it.

dates.label: Creation date
dates.meaning: When the booking record was created in the system. Close to the booking date but monthly counts differ by about 0.3–2%; use only when the question says created/creation.

dates.label: Travel date (check-in)
dates.meaning: Start of the service: hotel check-in, transfer or ticket date. Future months already hold bookings made for upcoming travel (data runs to 2028).

dates.label: Cancellation date
dates.meaning: When the booking was cancelled; "Unknown" for bookings not cancelled. Filled from September 2016.

dates.label: Booking date last year
dates.meaning: Technical: the same calendar date one year earlier, used only by the hidden LY helper measures.

dates.label: Booking date last year (same weekday)
dates.meaning: Technical: the date one year earlier shifted to the same weekday, used only by the hidden LYS helper measures.

measures.name: [% Base Profit]
measures.label: Base profit %
measures.definition: [Base Profit] ÷ [Amount].

measures.name: [Amount]
measures.label: Gross booked amount
measures.definition: Booked amount in AED including the full original value of lines later cancelled (unlike [Sale]). Base of [% Base Profit].
measures.notes: Over all years about 2.25 × [Sale] because cancelled bookings keep their amount. By cancellation date it gives the value of cancelled bookings.

measures.name: [Avg Cost]
measures.label: Average cost per booking
measures.definition: [Cost] ÷ [Reservations Count].

measures.name: [Avg Nights]
measures.label: Average nights per booking
measures.definition: [Nights] ÷ [Reservations Count].

measures.name: [Avg Paxes]
measures.label: Average passengers per booking
measures.definition: [Paxes] ÷ [Reservations Count].

measures.name: [Avg Profit]
measures.label: Average profit per booking
measures.definition: [Profit] ÷ [Reservations Count].

measures.name: [Avg Room Nights]
measures.label: Average nights per room
measures.definition: [Room Nights] ÷ [Rooms].
measures.notes: Divides by rooms, not by bookings.

measures.name: [Avg Sale]
measures.label: Average sale per booking
measures.definition: [Sale] ÷ [Reservations Count] (cancelled lines included).

measures.name: [Base Cost]
measures.label: Gross (base) cost
measures.definition: Supplier cost on the gross basis, including the original cost of lines later cancelled (pairs with [Amount]).

measures.name: [Base Profit]
measures.label: Base profit
measures.definition: Profit on the gross basis: [Amount] − [Base Cost] − [Base Supplier Commission]. Includes lines later cancelled; not the headline profit.
measures.notes: Much lower than [Profit] for live bookings and negative for the XML channel; only use when asked for base profit.

measures.name: [Base Supplier Commission]
measures.label: Supplier commission (base)
measures.definition: Supplier commission on the gross (base) basis; it is deducted in [Base Profit].
measures.notes: Includes lines later cancelled.

measures.name: [Cost]
measures.label: Cost
measures.definition: Supplier cost including tax, in AED. Cancelled lines keep only their cancellation cost.
measures.notes: [Final Cost] is identical in all data, so "final cost" is answered here.

measures.name: [Cost Tax]
measures.label: Tax on cost
measures.definition: Tax (VAT) included in the supplier cost.

measures.name: [Cost w/o Tax]
measures.label: Cost without tax
measures.definition: Supplier cost excluding tax: [Cost] − [Cost Tax].

measures.name: [Estimate Marketing Cost]
measures.label: Estimated marketing cost
measures.definition: Estimated marketing cost.
measures.hidden_reason: no data: 0 in all data (not populated)

measures.name: [Estimate Rappel Cost]
measures.label: Estimated rappel cost
measures.definition: Estimated volume-rebate (rappel) cost.
measures.hidden_reason: no data: 0 in all data (not populated)

measures.name: [Final Cost]
measures.label: Final cost
measures.definition: [Cost] plus estimated marketing and rappel costs.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate: identical to [Cost] in all data (the estimated costs are 0)

measures.name: [Final Profit]
measures.label: Final profit
measures.definition: [Final Sales] − [Final Cost]: [Profit] plus handling fees (estimated marketing and rappel costs are 0).
measures.notes: Differs from [Profit] by only about AED 3.7K over all years.

measures.name: [Final Profit %]
measures.label: Final profit %
measures.definition: [Final Profit] ÷ [Final Sales].
measures.notes: Practically equal to [Markup].

measures.name: [Final Profit Growth Opt]
measures.label: Final profit growth (optimisation)
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.

measures.name: [Final Profit Opt]
measures.label: Final profit (optimised)
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.
measures.hidden_reason: optimisation helper; always 0 (no booking is optimised)

measures.name: [Final Sales]
measures.label: Final sales
measures.definition: [Sale] plus fixed handling fees ([Handling Fee Fix]); the 'final' sales line of the company's model.
measures.notes: Differs from [Sale] by only about AED 3.7K over all years.

measures.name: [Final Sales Growth Opt]
measures.label: Final sales growth (optimisation)
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.

measures.name: [Final Sales Opt]
measures.label: Final sales (optimised)
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.
measures.hidden_reason: optimisation helper; always 0 (no booking is optimised)

measures.name: [Growth Due Optimization]
measures.label: Growth due to optimisation
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.

measures.name: [Handling Fee Fix]
measures.label: Handling fees
measures.definition: Fixed handling fees charged on bookings, in AED.
measures.notes: Small: about AED 3.7K over all years.

measures.name: [Markup]
measures.label: Margin on sales (Markup)
measures.definition: Profit as a share of sale (≈ [Profit] ÷ [Sale]) — a margin on sales, not profit ÷ cost.
measures.notes: Checked on real data: equals [Profit] ÷ [Sale] by channel (e.g. 4.2% XML, 8.0% B2B, 12.1% B2C); profit ÷ cost would be higher. See review bookings.markup_meaning.

measures.name: [Nights]
measures.label: Nights
measures.definition: Total nights booked (length of stay of each line), cancelled lines included.

measures.name: [Paxes]
measures.label: Passengers
measures.definition: Number of passengers (guests) on the booking lines, cancelled lines included.
measures.notes: Use this, not the broken [Pax].

measures.name: [Profit]
measures.label: Profit
measures.definition: [Sale] − [Cost], in AED (net of cancellations).
measures.notes: Most likely meaning of "profit" (see review bookings.profit_term).

measures.name: [Reservations Count]
measures.label: Bookings
measures.definition: Number of booking lines (reservation services), cancelled lines included.
measures.notes: The company's reports count bookings with this measure on 'Calendar'[Date]. About 40% of all lines are cancelled; add 'Canceled'[Canceled] = "No" for active/confirmed bookings. By cancellation date it counts cancellations.

measures.name: [Reservations Count Growth Opt]
measures.label: Bookings growth (optimisation)
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.

measures.name: [Reservations Count OPT]
measures.label: Bookings (optimised)
measures.definition: Optimisation helper.
measures.hidden_reason: optimisation helper; always 0 (no booking is optimised)

measures.name: [Room Nights]
measures.label: Room nights
measures.definition: Rooms × nights, cancelled lines included.

measures.name: [Rooms]
measures.label: Rooms
measures.definition: Number of rooms booked, cancelled lines included.

measures.name: [Sale]
measures.label: Sales
measures.definition: Sale amount including tax, in AED. Cancelled lines keep only their cancellation fees.
measures.notes: Most likely meaning of "sales" (see review bookings.sales_term). [Final Sales] adds only fixed handling fees; [Sale w/o Tax] removes VAT.

measures.name: [Sale Commission]
measures.label: Sale commission
measures.definition: Commission given to the selling customer.
measures.hidden_reason: practically no data (about AED 1K in all years, 0 in the last 12 months)

measures.name: [Sale Tax]
measures.label: Tax on sales
measures.definition: Tax (VAT) charged on sales.

measures.name: [Sale w/o Tax]
measures.label: Sales without tax
measures.definition: Sale amount excluding tax (VAT): [Sale] − [Sale Tax].

rules: Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.
List every breakdown column together with its needs_columns (group-with helper columns).

Plain period questions filter 'Calendar'[Date] (booking date); use 'Create Date'[Create Date] only when the question says created, 'Travel Date Start'[Travel Date Start] for travel/check-in and 'Cancelation Date'[Cancelation Date] for cancellations.

[Reservations Count], [Nights], [Room Nights], [Rooms], [Paxes], [Amount] and [Base Cost] include cancelled lines; [Sale], [Cost] and [Profit] are net of cancellations. Add 'Canceled'[Canceled] = "No" when the question asks for active, confirmed or net bookings.
Ratios and averages ([Markup], [Final Profit %], [% Base Profit], the Avg measures) are never added or averaged across rows; ask the cube for them at the level needed.
Never use the LY/LYS/Var/Opt measures or the 'Calendar'[Date LY] / [Date LY Slided] columns; compare periods by querying each period.
'Customers'[Market] and 'Customers'[Customer Country] describe the customer; 'Countries'[Country] and 'Areas' describe the destination.

review.question: Does "sales" mean Sale (with tax), Sale w/o Tax or Final Sales?
review.why: Sale is what the company's reports use. Final Sales only adds fixed handling fees (about AED 3.7K over all years); Sale w/o Tax is 1.5–2% lower (VAT removed).

review.question: Does "profit" mean Profit, Final Profit or Base Profit?
review.why: Profit = Sale − Cost, the pair of "sales". Final Profit only adds handling fees (about AED 3.7K overall). Base Profit is computed on gross amounts including cancelled bookings and is much lower (negative for XML).

review.question: The cube's Markup is profit ÷ sale (a margin), not profit ÷ cost. Should "markup" and "margin" both use it?
review.why: Both are profit ÷ sale and differ by under 0.01 points; Markup pairs with Profit and Sale. If people mean profit ÷ cost by "markup", answers would be slightly higher (7.4% instead of 6.9% over all years).

review.question: Should a plain "number of bookings" include cancelled booking lines?
review.why: [Reservations Count] counts all lines (about 40% cancelled over all years) and matches the company's reports; questions about active or confirmed bookings get the not-cancelled filter.
